title: 👀Proov!
tagline: Fotos & Videos with Built-in Truth: Tamper-proof media with ZK verifiable origins and authenticity.

prizes.title: Best use of ZK on Mopro

description:
Every photo you take becomes a tamper-proof capsule of truth — packed with cryptographic claims about its origin. Share just the image, or the full story. Reveal nothing, a little, or everything. Now or later. With Proov, truth is built-in, private by design, and verifiable at scale.



"Why Now" ?
The current landscape creates unprecedented demand for verifiable visual content:

AI content explosion → Real images now need proof to stand out
AI is making it easier than ever to fake reality — but harder than ever to trust the real thing
Misinformation risk → News, journalism, citizen reports demand source integrity
Privates, Companies, Institutions → All need verifiable visual data, not unreliable files
Zero-trust internet → Verifiable content becomes UX layer, not backend tool
Post-platform future → Our capsules work everywhere, from IG stories to DAO governance


✨ Unique Selling Proposition 
Zero-trust internet → Verifiable content becomes UX layer, not another faceless backend tool
Post-platform future → Our capsules work everywhere, from IG stories to DAO governance


✨ Killer Features
📸 One-tap proof generation — photo and cryptographic capsule created instantly
One-tap proof generation — no waiting, no manual steps
Selective privacy — share content, location, time, device, identity, or keep them sealed
⏳ Future disclosure — unlock more claims later without breaking the proof
🤖 Fake-resistant content — every photo becomes machine-verifiable, even against AI generation
Hardware integration — works with all smartphones and trusted camera devices
Proofs embedded into QR capsules — post them anywhere: Instagram, X, Telegram
🧳 Portable everywhere — works on Instagram, Twitter, Telegram — no platform lock-in
🧠 AI-generated image descriptions — embedded summaries for visual privacy or text-first sharing
how_its_made:
Core Technology Stack

Frontend & Mobile
React Native - Cross-platform mobile app development for iOS and Android
Enables single codebase for both platforms while maintaining native performance
Handles camera integration, UI/UX, and cryptographic proof generation on-device

Backend Infrastructure
Node.js servers - Handle API endpoints, proof verification, and business logic
Manages user authentication, metadata processing, and integration with partner services
Scalable architecture for handling cryptographic operations and data routing

Zero-Knowledge Proofs
Circom - Domain-specific language for writing arithmetic circuits
Circuit Multiplier 2 - Custom circuit implementation for efficient proof generation
Enables privacy-preserving verification of photo authenticity without revealing sensitive metadata



Partner Technologies & Integrations

Mopro Standard (Ethereum Foundation)
What it is: Mobile proving standard for zero-knowledge proofs
How it benefits: Provides standardized mobile ZK-proof generation framework
Integration: Enables efficient on-device proof creation without compromising user experience
Impact: Reduces proof generation time and battery consumption on mobile devices

Walrus (Storage Layer)
What it is: Decentralized storage network optimized for large data
How it benefits: Reliable, censorship-resistant storage for photo data and proofs
Integration: Stores encrypted photo capsules and cryptographic proofs
Impact: Ensures data persistence and availability across different platforms

Flow Blockchain
What it is: Developer-friendly blockchain for consumer applications
How it benefits: Fast, low-cost transactions with excellent mobile support
Integration: Handles proof verification, ownership tracking, and smart contract logic
Impact: Enables seamless blockchain interactions without typical crypto UX friction

IPFS (InterPlanetary File System)
What it is: Distributed file system for content-addressed storage
How it benefits: Provides content-addressable storage with built-in deduplication
Integration: Secondary storage layer for photo metadata and verification data
Impact: Ensures data integrity and enables decentralized content distribution

OpenAI Models
What it is: Large language models for image understanding and description
How it benefits: Generates contextual descriptions and metadata for photos
Integration: Powers AI-generated image descriptions embedded in proof capsules
Impact: Enables text-first sharing and enhanced privacy controls
